cases.title: POC-D01 SQLite 1M bar bulk write, S-09 version query, and S-01 Backup API snapshot/restore
cases.precondition: Temporary isolated data directory initialized with WAL + foreign_keys=ON.
steps: Insert 1,000,000 daily bar rows (200 instruments x 5,000 sessions) plus 10,000 revised rows at dataset_version=2.
Query 5,000 bars for a single instrument at version 1 and version 2 with S-09 interval condition.
Create a consistent backup via rusqlite::backup::Backup and restore into a clean directory, verifying all SHA-256 hashes.
cases.expected: Bulk write completes in < 10 s; 5,000-bar version query completes in < 50 ms; restored SQLite SHA-256 matches backup manifest with 0 FK violations.

cases.title: POC-D02 & S-06 Pure Rust XNYS/XNAS 1990-01-02..2027-12-31 day-by-day calendar verification
cases.precondition: Embedded calendar_special_xnys.json and reference fixtures xnys_1990_2023.csv + xnys_2023_2027.csv loaded.
steps: Generate XNYS calendar sessions for every calendar date in 1990-01-02..2027-12-31.
Compare trading/closed status, early closes (14:00 ET pre-1993, 13:00 ET 1993+), and UTC open/close timestamps against reference CSVs.
Query dates outside verified range (1989-12-29 and 2028-01-03).
cases.expected: Zero mismatches across all 13,878 calendar days (9,569 trading sessions); out-of-range dates return calendar_unknown.

cases.title: POC-D04 & S-08 US Equity raw price restoration (AAPL 2020-08-28 499.23) and cross-validation
cases.precondition: LoopbackTestServer bound strictly to 127.0.0.1:0 serving Yahoo Chart v8, EastMoney fqt=0, and Alpaca corporate action fixtures.
steps: Parse Yahoo Chart v8 AAPL JSON directly into Decimal without f64 intermediate.
Cross-validate against EastMoney push2his fqt=0 raw bars and simulate missing split jump.
cases.expected: Restored AAPL 2020-08-28 close equals 499.23 (0 bps diff vs EastMoney); simulated missing split emits missing_corporate_action quality issue.

cases.title: S-07 Fiat FX carried_forward (<= 4 days), inverse FX, and USDT/USDC market close valuation
cases.precondition: Frankfurter fiat FX and Coinbase/Bitstamp/Kraken stablecoin FX fixtures loaded.
steps: Query USD/HKD and USD/CNY on weekend/holiday non-publication dates (1..4 days gap vs >4 days gap).
Verify inverse FX rate calculation within the same dataset_version.
Verify USDT/USD and USDC/USD use actual market close (0.9998 / 1.0001) and never hardcode 1.0.
cases.expected: Gaps <= 4 days return carried_forward with source_date; gaps > 4 days return None (Partial valuation); stablecoins valued at actual close.

cases.title: POC-D03 OKX 1Dutc confirm filter and Binance archive ms/us timestamp & SHA-256 CHECKSUM verification
cases.precondition: OKX 1Dutc fixture (with confirm='0' and confirm='1') and Binance monthly ZIP archive + .CHECKSUM loaded.
steps: Parse OKX candles and verify unfinalized confirm='0' bars are excluded from finalized daily storage.
Verify SHA-256 .CHECKSUM of Binance ZIP archive and parse both 2024 millisecond (1735603200000) and 2025 microsecond (1740787200000000) timestamps.
Verify api.binance.com is rejected in favor of data-api.binance.vision / data.binance.vision.
Drive first backfill through monthly ZIP/CHECKSUM over loopback; checksum mismatch must publish neither version nor checkpoint.
cases.expected: Only finalized UTC daily bars are committed; both ms and us timestamps normalize to exact UTC dates.

cases.title: AC-01..AC-05 Double-entry balanced ledger, FIFO cost lots, third-asset fee disposal, splits/dividends, and transfers
cases.precondition: Clean ledger projection engine in delta-core.
steps: Replay deposits, multi-lot buys, partial sells, third-asset fee trades (OKB/BNB), 4:1 stock split, cash dividend, and cross-account cash/position transfers.
Verify every JournalTransaction has sum(book_amount) == 0.
Verify FIFO lot consumption, split quantity/cost invariant, and transfer lot acquisition date preservation.
cases.expected: All transactions balance to 0; FIFO realized PnL and remaining cost basis match exact Decimal expectations.

cases.title: AC-06..AC-07 Multi-currency valuation, price/FX impact decomposition, TWR/XIRR/drawdown, and technical indicators
cases.precondition: Committed ledger events and multi-source bars/FX in SqliteStore.
steps: Run evaluate_portfolio across USD/HKD/USDT holdings and verify price_gain_report + fx_translation_gain_report == total_unrealized_gain_report.
Compute TWR, XIRR (converged vs NoSignChange/NonConvergent), and max drawdown.
Compute SMA, EMA, MACD, RSI, ATR, and Bollinger Bands with visible_until truncation.
cases.expected: Valuation never fabricates 0 for missing inputs; indicators respect visible_until and exclude unfinalized bars.

cases.title: POC-D05 & AC-21 Statement import preview/commit for Futu, OKX, Generic, IBKR Flex XML, and Binance
cases.precondition: Synthetic statement fixtures for Futu (CN/EN), OKX, Generic, IBKR Flex XML, and Binance.

Preview and commit each preset, verifying idempotent skip on repeat file import and suspected_duplicate detection across files.
Verify automatic instrument and FX subscription registration on commit.
cases.expected: All 5 required presets import with 0 errors; repeat commit is idempotent; auto-subscriptions are persisted.

cases.title: AC-22 & AC-03 Committed event amendment via reversal + replacement in correction_group_id
cases.precondition: Committed ledger event and existing analysis_report in SqliteStore.
steps: Call amend_event on EV:ACC-GEN:GEN-0005:5 with updated quantity and price.
Verify original event is marked active_in_correction_group=0, reversal and replacement events are recorded in the same correction_group_id, and ledger_revision increments.
Verify prior analysis_report status is marked stale.
cases.expected: Original event preserved for audit; projection rebuilt from active events; prior reports marked stale.

cases.title: AC-09 Backup/restore integrity & AC-17 read-only account balance reconciliation
cases.precondition: Populated SqliteStore with ledger events and market data.
steps: Run reconcile_account with a mismatched observed balance snapshot and verify reconciliation_issue is recorded without mutating ledger events.
Create backup via create_backup and restore into a new target directory via restore_backup.
cases.expected: Reconciliation records exact difference while preserving ledger history; backup/restore verifies all SHA-256 hashes.

cases.title: AC-11 Replay truncation (visible_until) & AC-20 subset library export with S-05 terms_class
cases.precondition: Populated SqliteStore with dataset_version and terms_class metadata.
steps: Run export_library and verify ledger_events.csv, journal_postings.csv, cost_lots.csv, bars.csv, and export_manifest.json.
Verify export_manifest.json includes SHA-256 hashes, ledger_revision, dataset_version, and terms_classes.
cases.expected: All exported CSV hashes match export_manifest.json; terms_classes recorded accurately.

cases.title: S-02 Synchronous boundary scan & AC-16 background job panic/timeout/cancel isolation
cases.precondition: Workspace source files and JobController initialized.
steps: Scan crates/delta-core and crates/delta-app/src/lib.rs for forbidden async/tokio/reqwest leaks.
Spawn background jobs that panic, exceed timeout, or are cancelled, verifying structured ErrorEnvelope states.
cases.expected: Zero async/tokio/reqwest leaks in public boundary; job panic/timeout/cancel produce job_panicked/job_timed_out/job_cancelled without crashing host.

cases.title: S-04 Windows Credential Manager cross-process write/read/delete verification
cases.precondition: Windows Credential Manager accessible via keyring crate.
steps: Write a test credential under delta-test-<run_id>:tiingo in parent process.
Spawn child process (__internal-keyring-read) to read back the credential from Windows Credential Manager.
Delete the test credential and verify subsequent read returns NotFound.
cases.expected: Child process reads exact secret; credential entry is deleted and leaves 0 residual test credentials.

cases.title: S-10 Foreground quietness: CREATE_NO_WINDOW, SetErrorMode crash test, non-TTY immediate exit, control-char escaping, and 0 visible windows
cases.precondition: Windows quiet process guards and EnumWindows sentinel active.
steps: Scan source code for forbidden non-loopback address literals, excluding comment lines; the actual test listener only accepts the loopback address.
Timeout a temporary parent/descendant lock process tree and reacquire both locks, proving both processes exited without retaining stdout/stderr pipes.
Spawn __internal-crash-test child process that aborts, verifying SetErrorMode prevents WER popup.
Invoke 'delta library delete' in non-TTY mode without --yes, verifying immediate non-zero exit (< 1 s) without stdin hang.
Check EnumWindows visible_window_count == 0.
Initialize a real temporary library; verify exact confirmation_required_non_tty, then add one nested 22-byte synthetic file and verify preview/delete agree on file count and bytes.
cases.expected: visible_window_count == 0; timed-out process tree releases both locks; crash child exits quietly; initialized non-TTY delete refuses in under 1 second; explicit synthetic delete matches its preview.

cases.title: S-11 Cross-process LockFileEx delta.lock contention and recovery
cases.precondition: Temporary data directory with delta.lock.
steps: Spawn child process holding InstanceLock on delta.lock.
Attempt InstanceLock::acquire in parent process and measure failure latency.
Wait for child process exit and re-acquire lock.
cases.expected: Contending lock attempt fails in < 200 ms with InstanceLocked; lock succeeds immediately after holder exits.

cases.title: S-11 Channel path isolation (release/dev/source), SHGetKnownFolderPath, and non-writable no-fallback
cases.precondition: Channel resolver and %LOCALAPPDATA%\delta baseline snapshot.
steps: Verify source/dev channels resolve to delta-dev and never touch %LOCALAPPDATA%\delta.
Pass a regular file path as --data-dir and verify immediate DataDirNotWritable error without fallback.
Verify temp_residual_dirs == 0 and release_data_dir_touched == false after verify-stage.
cases.expected: Zero directories created outside temp root; %LOCALAPPDATA%\delta untouched.
